product_overview: FlowSpeak is a .NET backend service that authenticates users, interprets natural language commands with an AI model, and executes stock/order-related actions. It also exposes telemetry for recent AI command processing and supports product lookup and order management workflows.
core_goals: Provide secure user registration, login, token refresh, and logout using JWT cookies and hashed passwords
Accept natural language text, extract intent via Groq LLM, and dispatch the correct backend action
Support legacy structured intent processing for backward compatibility
Expose recent AI command telemetry for monitoring and troubleshooting
Enable product lookup and transactional order/stock reservation workflows with reliable data handling

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, refresh access, and log out using JWT-based authentication stored in HttpOnly cookies.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with username, password, fullName, and optional role -> Receive 200 with success message -> POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with user profile and HttpOnly auth cookies -> POST /api/auth/refresh with valid refresh cookie -> Receive 200 confirming tokens refreshed -> POST /api/auth/logout -> Receive 200 confirming logout
POST /api/auth/register with missing username or password -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/auth/register with a username that already exists -> Receive 409 conflict
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/auth/refresh with an invalid or expired refresh token cookie -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: AI Intent Interpretation
features.description: Accepts raw natural language input, uses the Groq LLM to extract intent, and dispatches execution to the appropriate handler for actions such as checking or reserving stock.
user_flows: POST /api/action/interpret with valid authenticated text input -> Receive 200 with extracted intent, message, and data payload
POST /api/action/interpret without a valid access token cookie -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/action/interpret with empty text -> Receive 400 bad request
POST /api/action/interpret with malformed or ambiguous input that cannot be mapped to an intent -> Receive 400 intent failed
POST /api/action/process with authenticated pre-parsed intent JSON -> Receive 200 with processed action result and data
POST /api/action/process with an unsupported intent or invalid parameters -> Receive 400 intent processing failed
POST /api/action/interpret when the AI provider or dispatcher throws an internal error -> Receive 500 server error

features.name: Telemetry Logs
features.description: Returns the most recent AI command execution logs so operators can inspect execution behavior and troubleshoot the AI pipeline.
user_flows: GET /api/telemetry/logs -> Receive 200 with the 50 most recent AI command log records ordered by processing time
GET /api/telemetry/logs during a normal operational period -> Receive 200 with telemetry entries suitable for monitoring recent intents
GET /api/telemetry/logs when no logs exist -> Receive 200 with an empty array
GET /api/telemetry/logs after a backend logging failure -> Receive 200 or empty results depending on storage state, with logs unavailable for the missing records

features.name: Product Lookup Service
features.description: Provides centralized fuzzy product search by name, SKU, or search vector while excluding soft-deleted items.
user_flows: POST /api/action/interpret with a product search request such as 'find SKU 12345' -> Receive 200 with intent resolved to product lookup-related action and matching product data
POST /api/action/interpret with a product search request for a soft-deleted or unavailable item -> Receive 200 with no match or empty data set
POST /api/action/interpret with a vague product query -> Receive 200 with best-effort fuzzy matches or a no-results response if the intent cannot be resolved
POST /api/action/interpret with a malformed or extremely noisy product query -> Receive 400 if the intent extraction fails

features.name: Order Management
features.description: Supports stock reservation and order creation with transactional integrity and GUID-based order identifiers to prevent race conditions.
user_flows: POST /api/action/interpret with a reserve-stock request containing a product and quantity -> Receive 200 with order or reservation confirmation data
POST /api/action/interpret with a request that would exceed available stock -> Receive 200 with a failure message or insufficient stock data from the handler
POST /api/action/interpret with two concurrent reserve-stock requests for the same inventory -> Receive one successful reservation and one failure based on transaction/locking behavior
POST /api/action/process with pre-parsed order intent and valid parameters -> Receive 200 with processed order result
POST /api/action/process with invalid quantity, missing product reference, or unsupported order intent -> Receive 400 intent processing failed
